QuestInfo.name: How to Enter?
QuestInfo.0: You met another Mapler at the Energy Laboratory. Should you try starting a conversation?
QuestInfo.1: You arrived at the Energy Laboratory but an Anti-Theft Laser is preventing your approach. There is a Teleport Device nearby which may allow you to pass through safely...
QuestInfo.2: The Teleport Device has been turned on! All that is left is to retrieve a Crystanol Fragment and return to the Time Machine.
